decision.Boris: Supports incomplete coverage for null/unreadable items and validated requested-ID fallback.
decision.Nadia: Initially proposed null as ordinary unavailable; after challenge supports incomplete coverage because null cannot establish intentional exclusion. Reviewed actual change without blocker.
decision.owner: Primary agent implemented HN-only classification; existing downstream states/UI reused.

verificationCorrections: Initial native fixture omitted required DJ news settings; supplied complete settings.
Initial native text locator matched visible and hidden-tab copies; scoped to active panels.
Final capture scrolled to draft warning before visual inspection.

acceptance.S07: Review; manual draft/details/bucket path checked; broader saved audio/current/scheduled scope retains prior evidence.
acceptance.A08: Review; scoped HN failure/no-news distinction checked.

limits: No actual provider output or live source relevance validation.
